lines: Enter a Woodland Mansion, defeat an evoker, and return with a Totem of Undying.
That chapter is closed. We already settled House of Ill Omens.
No one needs this done twice. You already came back from the Woodland Mansion with what we needed.
What was owed has been paid. House of Ill Omens is closed. I am not sending you through illagers in dark halls twice.
There is no second payment here. Your route to the Woodland Mansion is already in the informant record.
There is no second payment here. I remember the day you returned with the Totem of Undying.
That chapter is closed. You earned the reward for House of Ill Omens, and it was paid.
Your earlier work still stands. We have the stolen charm because you finished the journey to the Woodland Mansion.
I remember your first return. Nothing remains to be recovered from the mansion.
What was owed has been paid. What you brought from the Woodland Mansion is still helping the village.
We settled this one already. You proved the mansion route once. That is enough.
What was owed has been paid. The informant record carries your name beside the completed mark.
Your earlier work still stands. Leave House of Ill Omens in the past where it belongs.
What was owed has been paid. You settled every part of House of Ill Omens on your first return.
I will not reopen a finished account. The Woodland Mansion was reached and the Totem of Undying evidence delivered.
The matter ended well enough. I will find you a road beyond the Woodland Mansion before sending you back there.
The matter ended well enough. Nobody forgot what the journey to the Woodland Mansion cost you.
I remember your first return. House of Ill Omens at the Woodland Mansion needs no second visit from you.
There is no second payment here. You gave us the Totem of Undying, not another rumor.
Your earlier work still stands. House of Ill Omens ended properly, and it stays ended.
The matter ended well enough. We can look ahead now. House of Ill Omens is done.
I will post it when it matters. The conditions for House of Ill Omens are not right at the moment.
Not today. The mark for the Woodland Mansion is not open today.
The time is wrong. I have no reason to risk you against illagers in dark halls just now.
Nothing calls for this work today. The village is not ready to use a Totem of Undying and 12 emeralds.
The village can wait on this one. Wait until the informant record calls for the journey to the Woodland Mansion.
The village can wait on this one. A trip to the Woodland Mansion without a need is only danger.
The village can wait on this one. The mansion route can stay folded until the timing improves.
The time is wrong. I am holding House of Ill Omens off the board for now.
Not today. Nothing at the Woodland Mansion needs our answer today.
Nothing calls for this work today. Keep your gear ready for the Woodland Mansion, but do not leave yet.
Nothing calls for this work today. House of Ill Omens is real. The moment for it is not.
The board can wait. I will not send you toward illagers in dark halls to satisfy an old note.
Nothing calls for this work today. The Woodland Mansion can wait until we have a use for the return.
The village can wait on this one. Ask again after the village reviews the informant record.
The time is wrong. There is no active claim on the Totem of Undying today.
Leave that work alone for now. The road toward the Woodland Mansion is quiet, and I mean to leave it that way.
I am keeping this off the board. Starting House of Ill Omens now would spend courage for no useful result.
For now, let the matter rest. House of Ill Omens has not been posted to any traveler.
Ask me after the stores change. Give House of Ill Omens time to become necessary.
There is no reason to begin yet. For the moment, stay on this side of the journey to the Woodland Mansion.
I cannot send you out blind. The mansion is beyond my reach today. The woods are keeping their mouth shut.
I will not guess at a route. I cannot put a trustworthy mark on the Woodland Mansion.
Until I know the way, you stay here. Every route I checked breaks down before the mansion.
No mark is better than a false one. The Woodland Mansion maps disagree, and illagers in dark halls leave no room for guessing.
The search turned up nothing solid. I found rumors of the Woodland Mansion, but no road I would hand you.
My map has failed us. The Woodland Mansion has slipped beyond my Woodland Mansion charts.
I will not guess at a route. Without a firm bearing, House of Ill Omens would be wandering.
The search turned up nothing solid. My best map is blank where the mansion should be.
The search turned up nothing solid. I traced three routes toward the Woodland Mansion and trusted none.
I cannot send you out blind. The old Woodland Mansion directions end before danger begins.
The trail has gone cold. I will not pretend a guess can mark the Woodland Mansion.
Until I know the way, you stay here. No scout has confirmed the mark for the Woodland Mansion.
I found no safe bearing to give you. The trail to the Woodland Mansion went cold before I could mark it.
A doubtful map is too much risk. I need Woodland Mansion coordinates, not campfire stories.
The trail has gone cold. The Woodland Mansion may be there, but I cannot prove where.
I found no safe bearing to give you. None of the Woodland Mansion bearings lead to the same ground.
We need a trustworthy route first. Let me find an honest mansion route before you prepare to leave.
The search turned up nothing solid. The informant record offers warnings today, not directions.
I cannot send you out blind. The Woodland Mansion map gives me doubt when I need certainty.
Something is wrong with the chart. Come back after the road to the Woodland Mansion gives us an answer.
I cannot sign off on an empty return. Bring the Totem. Nothing else carries enough of that house on it.
You returned without the one thing I asked for. The Totem of Undying is still missing from your return.
I cannot sign off on an empty return. I cannot close the informant record without the agreed Totem of Undying evidence.
The evidence still matters. You faced the Woodland Mansion, but the village still needs the Totem of Undying.
The last requirement is still missing. Bring back a Totem of Undying and 12 emeralds before we settle House of Ill Omens.
I need something I can hold. Your story may be true. I still need the Totem of Undying.
A story cannot close the ledger. The journey to the Woodland Mansion ends here when the Totem of Undying changes hands.
The proof has to reach my hands. Do not reach the Woodland Mansion and forget the Totem of Undying that verifies it.
The proof has to reach my hands. I know you traveled. I need a result from the Woodland Mansion.
I cannot sign off on an empty return. The House of Ill Omens reward waits on the Totem of Undying evidence, not the telling.
The evidence still matters. Show me the Totem of Undying, and House of Ill Omens can close.
The proof has to reach my hands. The empty place in the informant record waits for what you recovered.
I need something I can hold. Words cannot stand in for the stolen charm.
Bring back something the village can verify. Check your packs before you make the journey to the Woodland Mansion twice.
Bring back something the village can verify. House of Ill Omens named its proof from the beginning.
Show me what came back with you. Bring the Totem of Undying evidence here rather than leaving it in storage.
I need something I can hold. The village asked for a Totem of Undying and 12 emeralds, and that remains unfinished.
Bring back something the village can verify. I can record the mansion route after I see what came from it.
The evidence still matters. One Totem of Undying handoff separates House of Ill Omens from completion.
Bring back something the village can verify. Return when the Totem of Undying is in your hands.
The journey stopped too soon. The totem needs the mansion behind it. I need the place confirmed.
Finish the outward journey first. You have not confirmed the Woodland Mansion itself.
The road must end where I sent you. The cargo means little if the Woodland Mansion was never reached.
Going near it does not count. House of Ill Omens includes the road as well as the return.
This task was never only about the cargo. Set foot in the mansion before you bring me evidence.
Reaching the mark is part of the promise. I asked for proof from the Woodland Mansion, not somewhere else.
You have not gone far enough yet. The Woodland Mansion remains untouched in the informant record.
You cannot skip the heart of the task. Finish the outward journey before claiming the House of Ill Omens reward.
The map still shows unfinished travel. A borrowed Totem of Undying cannot replace reaching the Woodland Mansion.
The place itself must be reached. The Woodland Mansion map still says you stopped short.
Reaching the mark is part of the promise. Go to the marked place and see House of Ill Omens through there.
This task was never only about the cargo. The mansion route must end at the Woodland Mansion, not near it.
Going near it does not count. I need your eyes on the Woodland Mansion before I trust the report.
Reaching the mark is part of the promise. Do not skip the part that puts illagers in dark halls in front of you.
The place itself must be reached. The village asked you to confirm the mansion existed.
This task was never only about the cargo. Your return is early. the Woodland Mansion still waits.
You still owe the road its last mile. Reach the Woodland Mansion, then recover a Totem of Undying and 12 emeralds.
Finish the outward journey first. The journey to the Woodland Mansion is not complete while the final mark is unvisited.
This task was never only about the cargo. The informant record needs a confirmed place, not only an item.
I need the site confirmed. Turn back toward the Woodland Mansion and finish what you began.

Keep the whole task in mind. The Woodland Mansion is still near {target_x}, {target_z}.

The next step still matters. Check the map again. Woodland Mansion is still near {target_x}, {target_z}.
Stay with the work you accepted. House of Ill Omens still calls for a Totem of Undying and 12 emeralds.
Stay with the work you accepted. Watch for illagers in dark halls on the way in.
Keep the return trip in your plans. Do not leave the Woodland Mansion without the Totem of Undying.
Hold to the instructions I gave you. Your return should give us the stolen charm.
Remember what the village is waiting for. Check the Woodland Mansion bearing at {target_x}, {target_z} before landmarks blur.
Hold to the instructions I gave you. Keep the Totem of Undying safe once you recover it.
The next step still matters. The informant record stays open until you come home.
Keep the return trip in your plans. Do not rush blind toward the Woodland Mansion. Follow the mark and return whole.
Do not lose the thread now. The Woodland Mansion has not moved from {target_x}, {target_z}.
Bring this to a proper finish. Remember why you are going. We need to defeat the evoker and pay the informants.
Keep the return trip in your plans. If the mansion route feels wrong, check your position against {target_x}, {target_z}.
Hold to the instructions I gave you. The hard part is reaching the mansion and leaving with evidence.
Do not let one finished step distract you. Woodland Mansion still waits near {target_x}, {target_z}.
Stay with the work you accepted. Bring every part of a Totem of Undying and 12 emeralds back together.

Stay with the work you accepted. Find the Woodland Mansion, do House of Ill Omens there, and return to me.
Here is the work. The mansion lies {direction}, around {distance} blocks away, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Defeat its evoker, bring a Totem of Undying, and set aside 12 emeralds for informants.
I have a difficult request. I marked the Woodland Mansion near {target_x}, {target_z}.
Take the task only if you are ready. Travel {direction} for about {distance} blocks and look for the mansion.
There is a reason I chose you. The job is to defeat the evoker and pay the informants.
Listen closely. Come home with a Totem of Undying and 12 emeralds so the village has more than rumors.
Take this seriously. The road leads through illagers in dark halls, so prepare before leaving.

There is a reason I chose you. Bring a Totem of Undying and 12 emeralds, and I can turn this risk into something useful.
Take the task only if you are ready. The village needs the stolen charm, not boasting at the fire.
Listen closely. I trust you with the mansion route because it is not kind.
Before you agree, hear all of it. Make for {target_x}, {target_z} and confirm the Woodland Mansion yourself.
Take this seriously. Prepare for illagers in dark halls before crossing the last safe ground.
This needs a careful hand. The outward journey proves the Woodland Mansion map. The return proves you.
This needs a careful hand. Do not come back empty from the mansion.
Take the task only if you are ready. Take House of Ill Omens only if you mean to finish the travel and recovery.
I need you to see this through. When you have a Totem of Undying and 12 emeralds, bring it straight here.
That is the result I needed. A Totem of Undying. That is not proof of safety, but it is proof the village has a shield with a name.
You saw it through. You reached the Woodland Mansion and brought the Totem of Undying home.
Good, you made it back. The informant record finally has a true ending.
Good, you made it back. This is the stolen charm, solid enough to hold.
You brought the work to a proper end. The village can defeat the evoker and pay the informants because you took the risk.
This return was worth waiting for. I asked for a Totem of Undying and 12 emeralds, and you returned with every part.
You saw it through. You went through illagers in dark halls and kept your head.
That settles what I asked of you. The mansion route is confirmed now, not merely drawn.
You delivered exactly what was needed. I can pay House of Ill Omens without a doubt.
You delivered exactly what was needed. The Totem of Undying tells the story better than any boast.
This return was worth waiting for. You made the dangerous road to the Woodland Mansion useful to everyone here.
Good, you made it back. The Woodland Mansion is no longer just a warning on a map.
Now I can close the ledger. I will put your Woodland Mansion findings where the village can study them.
You delivered exactly what was needed. House of Ill Omens is clean, even if the journey to the Woodland Mansion was not.
That is the result I needed. That is the Totem of Undying evidence I hoped to see.
You brought the work to a proper end. You returned from the Woodland Mansion with more than survival. You brought an answer.
That settles what I asked of you. House of Ill Omens closes with the village better prepared.
The hard part is behind us. The next traveler to the Woodland Mansion will have your route.
You saw it through. Take the House of Ill Omens reward. You earned it beyond the safe roads.
This return was worth waiting for. I am glad to see both the Totem of Undying and person carrying it.
I cannot trust you with this yet. This is not a request for someone the village only half trusts.

The village needs a steadier hand. I cannot hand you a route through illagers in dark halls today.
This calls for someone we know better. The Woodland Mansion is no ground for an untested ally.
Come back after you have earned more trust. Do steadier work here before asking for the Woodland Mansion map.
Come back after you have earned more trust. I need someone I can trust to return from the Woodland Mansion.
I need proof of your judgment first. The informant record stays closed to you for now.
Come back after you have earned more trust. House of Ill Omens risks more than the traveler's life.
The answer is no for now. Earn our confidence, then ask about the mansion again.
Some work must wait until trust catches up. I will not send a stranger after the stolen charm.
The answer is no for now. The Woodland Mansion is dangerous enough without doubt between us.
This calls for someone we know better. Your name has not reached the trusted page of the informant record.
I cannot trust you with this yet. There are safer tasks than House of Ill Omens that can show me how you work.
The answer is no for now. I need proof of judgment before offering the journey to the Woodland Mansion.
Come back after you have earned more trust. For now, the Woodland Mansion map remains folded.
The village needs a steadier hand. The village is not ready to stake defeat the evoker and pay the informants on you.
Come back after you have earned more trust. Ask about the Woodland Mansion after you have stood with us longer.
Some work must wait until trust catches up. Courage may reach the Woodland Mansion. Reliability brings the Totem of Undying home.
I cannot trust you with this yet. House of Ill Omens stays with proven hands.
You are not ready for this request. I will tell you when we trust you with the road to the Woodland Mansion.

Bring 12 emeralds to repay informants after the evoker falls.
